paper_title: 1.4 Million Open-Source Distilled Reasoning Dataset to Empower Large   Language Model Training
caption: Difficulty distribution of the data entries. Most of the dataset entries are classified as Medium (51.8%) or Hard (25.7%). A smaller proportion falls into the Easy (11.2%), Very Hard (6.5%), and Very Easy (4.7%) categories.
model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of difficulty levels within a dataset. The chart is divided into four categories: Very easy, Easy, Medium, Hard, and Very hard, totaling four slices. The slices are colored teal, light green, coral, and blue, respectively. Percentage labels are provided for each slice, indicating Very easy represents 4.7%, Easy accounts for 11.2%, Medium comprises 51.8%, Hard represents 25.7%, and Very hard is 6.5%. There is no legend provided, and no slices are visually emphasized. The segments are ordered with the largest slice (Medium) positioned at the bottom left, and appear to decrease in size clockwise.
